```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
source(file.path("R", "common.R"))
library(knitr)
TEX <- "results_gm12878_parameters.tex"
# check a quoted value given to `digits` decimals: ok if it is the computed value rounded (half up
# or half down, so 93.45 may be quoted as 93.4 or 93.5)
chk <- function(label, value, quoted, digits = 1) {
  check_text(label, round(value, digits + 2), quoted, tol = 0.5 * 10^-digits + 1e-6)
  invisible(value)
}
```

This notebook supports the Results section "Parameter choices on real assemblies"
([`../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_parameters.tex`](../manuscript/sections/results_gm12878_parameters.tex),
`sec:parameters`) and Fig. 7 (`fig:parameters`, caption in
[`figures_main.tex`](../manuscript/sections/figures_main.tex)). It draws Fig. 7
(`figures/fig7_parameters.{pdf,png}`) and computes the numbers the section quotes.
Provenance: `r evidence("E40")` (release reruns of the start grid, the minimum-length and q-value comparisons, with Trinity added),
`r evidence("E06")` (homology series), `r evidence("E25")` (release runs), `r evidence("E13")` and `r evidence("E04")`
(the earlier development versions of these analyses).

**Which runs.** Everything here is PyTD d3892b5 (E40) at the release defaults, or an option of that code. The homology
series was run at a5b24c3, whose code tree is identical to d3892b5 (only documentation differs). No development
run is used in this notebook.

```{r data}
ASM <- c("lraa", "stringtie", "trinity")
SHORT <- c(lraa = "LRAA", stringtie = "StringTie", trinity = "Trinity")
asm_factor <- function(x) factor(x, levels = ASM, labels = ASM_LABEL[ASM])

gmr <- read_tab("gm12878", "release_pin", "gm_runs.tsv")
gm_v <- function(a, cfg, col) gmr[[col]][gmr$assembly == a & gmr$config == cfg]
grid <- gmr %>% filter(config == "norefine" | grepl("^a[0-9.]+_w", config)) %>%
  mutate(alpha = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(alpha)), weight = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(weight)))
sweep_v7 <- read_tab("gm12878", "final_v7", "08_minaa_sweep_v7.tsv")
by_len <- read_tab("gm12878", "release_pin", "no_overlap_by_length.tsv") %>% mutate(frac = no_gencode_cds_overlap / n)
pm <- read_tab("gm12878", "release_pin", "protein_matches.tsv") %>% separate(label, c("assembly", "setting"), sep = "[.]")
sup_v7 <- read_tab("gm12878", "release_pin", "rule_support.tsv")
hom <- read_tab("gm12878", "gm12878_homology_series_v7h.tsv")
ret_txt <- readLines(data_path("gm12878", "gm12878_homology_primate_retention_v7h.txt"))
te_screen <- read_tab("gm12878", "gm12878_te_screen_v7h.tsv")
```

## Start refinement {#start-refinement}

Source: `data/gm12878/release_pin/gm_runs.tsv` (E40; PyTD d3892b5 on all three assemblies, fresh runs). The
grid is alpha {0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 1} x w {0, 17, 35} bases per bit, plus `--no-refine-starts`. The default cell
`a0.4_w17` is byte-identical to the release default run `rel`. It replaces the development grid of E13
(48c870c, LRAA and StringTie, w in nats), which also had the fixed short-ORF test.

```{r start}
g <- function(a, cfg, col) grid[[col]][grid$assembly == a & grid$config == cfg]
stopifnot(all(sapply(ASM, function(a) g(a, "a0.4_w17", "MANE_exact") == gm_v(a, "rel", "MANE_exact"))))
start_tab <- grid %>% filter(config %in% c("norefine", "a0.4_w0", "a0.4_w17", "a1_w17")) %>%
  transmute(assembly, config, `MANE exact given assembled` = MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
            `complete, GENCODE exact` = pred_complete_gencode_exact,
            `complete, compatible not exact` = pred_complete_compatible_not_exact,
            `5'-partial` = distinct_predicted_5prime_partial,
            `exact-start share` = pred_complete_start_precision)
kable(start_tab)
M <- "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"; X <- "pred_complete_gencode_exact"; PP <- "distinct_predicted_5prime_partial"
SH <- "pred_complete_start_precision"; WS <- "pred_complete_compatible_not_exact"
dpt <- function(a, c1, c2, col) 100 * (g(a, c1, col) - g(a, c2, col))
pv3 <- function(cfg, col) paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(g(a, cfg, col))), collapse = ", ")
nv3 <- function(cfg, col) paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) num(g(a, cfg, col))), collapse = ", ")
```

Values below are LRAA, StringTie, Trinity.

- Exact recovery of fully assembled MANE CDSs: no refinement `r pv3("norefine", M)`; default `r pv3("a0.4_w17", M)`.
- Exact complete calls: `r nv3("norefine", X)` to `r nv3("a0.4_w17", X)`. 5'-partial calls:
  `r nv3("norefine", PP)` to `r nv3("a0.4_w17", PP)`.
- Exact-start share of GENCODE-compatible complete calls: `r pv3("norefine", SH)` to `r pv3("a0.4_w17", SH)`.
- Wrong-start complete calls: `r nv3("norefine", WS)` to `r nv3("a0.4_w17", WS)`.
- Kozak term (w 17 vs 0 at alpha 0.4): `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) f1(dpt(a, "a0.4_w17", "a0.4_w0", M))), collapse = ", ")`
  points of MANE exact recovery; `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) f1(dpt(a, "a0.4_w17", "a0.4_w0", SH))), collapse = ", ")`
  points of exact-start share.
- alpha 0.4 to 1: MANE exact given assembled `r pv3("a1_w17", M)`; wrong-start complete calls `r nv3("a1_w17", WS)`;
  exact-start share `r pv3("a1_w17", SH)`.

`r evidence("E40")`

```{r chk_start, include = FALSE}
chk_set <- function(lab, cfg, col, q, scale = 100, digits = 1) for (a in ASM)
  chk(paste(lab, ASM_LABEL[[a]]), scale * g(a, cfg, col), q[[a]], digits)
cnt_set <- function(lab, cfg, col, q) for (a in ASM) check_text(paste(lab, ASM_LABEL[[a]]), g(a, cfg, col), q[[a]])
chk_set("MANE exact given assembled, no refinement (%)", "norefine", M, c(lraa=58.6, stringtie=60.3, trinity=63.3))
chk_set("MANE exact given assembled, default (%)", "a0.4_w17", M, c(lraa=92.9, stringtie=91.5, trinity=89.3))
cnt_set("exact complete calls, no refinement", "norefine", X, c(lraa=7420, stringtie=9044, trinity=9622))
cnt_set("exact complete calls, default", "a0.4_w17", X, c(lraa=11828, stringtie=13395, trinity=13380))
cnt_set("5'-partial, no refinement", "norefine", PP, c(lraa=10348, stringtie=9483, trinity=16006))
cnt_set("5'-partial, default", "a0.4_w17", PP, c(lraa=2502, stringtie=2646, trinity=5931))
chk_set("exact-start share, no refinement (%)", "norefine", SH, c(lraa=82.2, stringtie=73.9, trinity=53.1))
chk_set("exact-start share, default (%)", "a0.4_w17", SH, c(lraa=84.8, stringtie=79.0, trinity=58.7))
cnt_set("wrong-start complete, no refinement", "norefine", WS, c(lraa=1609, stringtie=3190, trinity=8510))
cnt_set("wrong-start complete, default", "a0.4_w17", WS, c(lraa=2113, stringtie=3556, trinity=9413))
for (x in list(c("lraa", 2.9), c("stringtie", 3.0), c("trinity", 2.1))) chk(paste("Kozak term, MANE exact (points)", x[1]), dpt(x[1], "a0.4_w17", "a0.4_w0", M), as.numeric(x[2]))
for (x in list(c("lraa", 1.1), c("stringtie", 0.7), c("trinity", 0.8))) chk(paste("Kozak term, exact-start share (points)", x[1]), dpt(x[1], "a0.4_w17", "a0.4_w0", SH), as.numeric(x[2]))
chk_set("MANE exact given assembled, alpha 1 (%)", "a1_w17", M, c(lraa=94.9, stringtie=93.7, trinity=91.1))
chk_set("exact-start share, alpha 1 (%)", "a1_w17", SH, c(lraa=81.9, stringtie=77.5, trinity=56.6))
# caption of Fig. 7a: no-refinement values
chk_set("caption 7a no refinement MANE", "norefine", M, c(lraa=0.59, stringtie=0.60, trinity=0.63), 1, 2)
chk_set("caption 7a no refinement exact-start share", "norefine", SH, c(lraa=0.82, stringtie=0.74, trinity=0.53), 1, 2)
```

## Minimum length and the q-value cutoff {#minimum-length-and-the-q-value-cutoff}

### A 50-codon minimum without a test {#minimum-without-test}

Release code with the q-value test switched off (`--max-qvalue 1000000`, because estimated FDRs can exceed 1):
`m100_noq` (LongOrfs `-m 100`) and `m50_noq` (`-m 50`). The frame test ($S_1>0$, $C>0$) and the long-ORF rule stay on.

```{r m50}
m50_tab <- gmr %>% filter(config %in% c("m100_noq", "m50_noq", "rel")) %>%
  transmute(assembly, config, distinct_cds = distinct_predicted_cds, MANE_exact_given_assembled = MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
            no_GENCODE_overlap = pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac)
kable(m50_tab)
nov <- function(a, cfg) m50_tab$no_GENCODE_overlap[m50_tab$assembly == a & m50_tab$config == cfg]
```

No GENCODE CDS overlap, `-m 100` to `-m 50` without a test: `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) paste(pct(nov(a,"m100_noq")), "to", pct(nov(a,"m50_noq")))), collapse = "; ")`
(LRAA; StringTie; Trinity). The release default gives `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(nov(a,"rel"))), collapse = ", ")`.

`r evidence("E40")`

```{r chk_m50, include = FALSE}
chk("LRAA no-overlap, -m 100 (%)", 100 * nov("lraa", "m100_noq"), 3.6)
chk("LRAA no-overlap, -m 50 no test (%)", 100 * nov("lraa", "m50_noq"), 10.7)
chk("StringTie no-overlap, -m 100 (%)", 100 * nov("stringtie", "m100_noq"), 11.8)
chk("StringTie no-overlap, -m 50 no test (%)", 100 * nov("stringtie", "m50_noq"), 34.7)
chk("Trinity no-overlap, -m 100 (%)", 100 * nov("trinity", "m100_noq"), 15.4)
chk("Trinity no-overlap, -m 50 no test (%)", 100 * nov("trinity", "m50_noq"), 53.8)
```

### Matching and non-matching proteins by q setting {#q-settings}

Predicted proteins identical to, or sharing an exact 30-residue window with, a GENCODE v50 protein
are "matching"; the rest are "non-matching" (`score_protein_matches.py`; `data/gm12878/release_pin/protein_matches.tsv`, E40).

```{r qset}
SETTING <- c(precise = "q 0.01 (--precise)", default = "q 0.05 (default)", sensitive = "q 0.2 (--sensitive)")
q_tab <- pm %>% filter(setting %in% c("rel", "precise", "sensitive")) %>%
  mutate(setting = recode(setting, rel = "default")) %>%
  select(assembly, setting, matching = true_positives, nonmatching) %>%
  mutate(cfg = recode(setting, default = "rel"),
         no_GENCODE_overlap = mapply(gm_v, assembly, cfg, "pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"),
         MANE_exact_given_assembled = mapply(gm_v, assembly, cfg, "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"),
         catalog_riboseq_orfs = mapply(gm_v, assembly, cfg, "ribo_catalog_stop_match"))
noq <- pm %>% filter(setting == "m50_noq") %>% select(assembly, matching = true_positives, nonmatching)
kable(q_tab %>% mutate(setting = SETTING[setting]) %>% select(-cfg))
kable(noq, caption = "No q-value test, 50-codon minimum")
q <- function(a, s, col) q_tab[[col]][q_tab$assembly == a & q_tab$setting == s]
nq <- function(a, col) noq[[col]][noq$assembly == a]
fold <- sapply(ASM, function(a) nq(a, "nonmatching") / q(a, "default", "nonmatching"))
loss <- sapply(ASM, function(a) 1 - q(a, "default", "matching") / nq(a, "matching"))
kable(tibble(assembly = ASM, fold_fewer_nonmatching = fold, loss_of_matching = loss), digits = 3)
```

At the default, against no q-value test, non-matching proteins fell `r paste(sprintf("%.1f", fold), collapse = ", ")`-fold for a loss of
`r paste(pct(loss), collapse = ", ")` of matching ones (LRAA, StringTie, Trinity).
Catalogued Ribo-seq ORFs matched by stop codon: `r paste(sapply(ASM, gm_v, "m50_noq", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), collapse = ", ")` without the test,
`r paste(sapply(ASM, gm_v, "rel", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), collapse = ", ")` at the default,
`r paste(sapply(ASM, gm_v, "m100_noq", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), collapse = ", ")` at a plain 100-codon minimum and
`r paste(sapply(ASM, gm_v, "sensitive", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), collapse = ", ")` with `--sensitive`.

`r evidence("E40")`

```{r chk_q, include = FALSE}
Q <- function(a, s, m, n) { check_text(paste(a, s, "matching"), q(a, s, "matching"), m); check_text(paste(a, s, "non-matching"), q(a, s, "nonmatching"), n) }
Q("lraa", "default", 32751, 277); Q("stringtie", "default", 35294, 1185); Q("trinity", "default", 78181, 2616)
Q("lraa", "precise", 31672, 189); Q("stringtie", "precise", 33647, 698); Q("trinity", "precise", 74117, 1301)
Q("lraa", "sensitive", 33443, 560); Q("stringtie", "sensitive", 36903, 2879); Q("trinity", "sensitive", 82130, 7482)
for (x in list(c("lraa", 34382, 3690), c("stringtie", 38575, 18278), c("trinity", 88821, 97397))) {
  check_text(paste(x[1], "no q test, matching"), nq(x[1], "matching"), as.numeric(x[2]))
  check_text(paste(x[1], "no q test, non-matching"), nq(x[1], "nonmatching"), as.numeric(x[3])) }
chk("fold fewer non-matching, low end", min(fold), 13.3)
chk("fold fewer non-matching, high end", max(fold), 37.2)
chk("loss of matching, low end (%)", 100 * min(loss), 4.7)
chk("loss of matching, high end (%)", 100 * max(loss), 12.0)
for (x in list(c("lraa", 458, 101, 184, 144), c("stringtie", 578, 95, 221, 165), c("trinity", 1195, 186, 451, 295))) {
  a <- x[1]; v <- as.numeric(x[2:5])
  check_text(paste(a, "catalogue matches no test"), gm_v(a, "m50_noq", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), v[1])
  check_text(paste(a, "catalogue matches default"), gm_v(a, "rel", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), v[2])
  check_text(paste(a, "catalogue matches 100 codons"), gm_v(a, "m100_noq", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), v[3])
  check_text(paste(a, "catalogue matches --sensitive"), gm_v(a, "sensitive", "ribo_catalog_stop_match"), v[4]) }
```

### Support of the ORFs that the q-value test removed {#removed-orf-support}

`data/gm12878/release_pin/rule_support.tsv` (`pipeline/release_pin/14_rule_support_v1.py`, E40). Removed ORFs:
predictions of the release code with the q-value test off (`m50_noq`) whose stop codon is not predicted at
the release default; ORFs are identified by transcript, strand and stop. Ribo-seq rates are over ORFs
with at least ten P-sites; MS rates are over all ORFs (gene models).

```{r support}
kable(sup_v7, caption = "Release code, q-value test off against the default")
s7 <- function(a, set, col) sup_v7[[col]][sup_v7$asm == a & sup_v7$set == set]
```

ORFs removed vs all default predictions (LRAA; StringTie; Trinity):

- Ribo-seq frame test passed: `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(s7(a,"removed","ribo_rate"), 0)), collapse = ", ")`
  of removed ORFs with enough footprints (n = `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) num(s7(a,"removed","ribo_n"))), collapse = ", ")`), against
  `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(s7(a,"all","ribo_rate"), 0)), collapse = ", ")` of all predictions.
- MS peptide: `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(s7(a,"removed","ms_rate"), 0)), collapse = ", ")` against
  `r paste(sapply(ASM, function(a) pct(s7(a,"all","ms_rate"), 0)), collapse = ", ")`.

`r evidence("E40")`, `r evidence("E01")`, `r evidence("E02")`

```{r chk_support, include = FALSE}
for (x in list(c("lraa", 40, 66, 21, 64), c("stringtie", 37, 62, 9, 69), c("trinity", 40, 61, 6, 65))) {
  a <- x[1]; v <- as.numeric(x[2:5])
  chk(paste(a, "removed ORFs, Ribo-seq frame test (%)"), 100 * s7(a, "removed", "ribo_rate"), v[1], 0)
  chk(paste(a, "all predictions, Ribo-seq frame test (%)"), 100 * s7(a, "all", "ribo_rate"), v[2], 0)
  chk(paste(a, "removed ORFs, MS peptide (%)"), 100 * s7(a, "removed", "ms_rate"), v[3], 0)
  chk(paste(a, "all predictions, MS peptide (%)"), 100 * s7(a, "all", "ms_rate"), v[4], 0) }
```

### Unannotated predictions by length {#unannotated-by-length}

From the pinned-commit `pred_status` tables (`data/gm12878/release_pin/no_overlap_by_length.tsv`;
predicted protein length, the first bin includes the few predictions under 50 aa).

```{r bylen}
bl <- by_len %>% mutate(pct = round(100 * frac, 1)) %>%
  select(assembly, config, length_bin, n, pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = length_bin, values_from = c(n, pct))
kable(bl)
short_rel <- by_len %>% filter(config == "rel", length_bin %in% c("<100", "100-149"))
long_rel <- by_len %>% filter(config == "rel", length_bin == ">=300")
```

Release defaults: `r pct(min(short_rel$frac), 0)`--`r pct(max(short_rel$frac), 0)` of predictions
shorter than 100 aa or of 100--149 aa have no GENCODE CDS overlap, against
`r pct(min(long_rel$frac))`--`r pct(max(long_rel$frac))` of those of at least 300 aa.

```{r chk_bylen, include = FALSE}
chk("L50 short predictions no-overlap, low end (%)", 100 * min(short_rel$frac), 5, 0)
chk("L50 short predictions no-overlap, high end (%)", 100 * max(short_rel$frac), 19, 0)
chk("L50 >=300 aa no-overlap, low end (%)", 100 * min(long_rel$frac), 0.4)
chk("L50 >=300 aa no-overlap, high end (%)", 100 * max(long_rel$frac), 1.2)
```

### Post-hoc minimum length {#post-hoc-minimum-length}

`eval_genome_cds.py --min-aa L` on the release default predictions
(`data/gm12878/final_v7/08_minaa_sweep_v7.tsv`, `pipeline/derive/08_minaa_sweep_final_v7.sh`; those predictions are
byte-identical at the pinned commit, E40). The filter keeps predictions
encoding at least L aa (stop excluded); it is applied after prediction, so training and
per-transcript selection still see all candidates.

```{r minaa}
mt <- sweep_v7 %>% select(assembly, min_aa, distinct_predicted_cds, MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
                          pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac)
kable(mt, digits = 4)
mv <- function(a, L, col) sweep_v7[[col]][sweep_v7$assembly == a & sweep_v7$min_aa == L]
full_mane <- sapply(ASM, gm_v, "rel", "MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled")
```

Removing release predictions below 150 aa cuts the no-overlap share to
`r pct(mv("lraa",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))` (LRAA),
`r pct(mv("stringtie",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))` (StringTie) and
`r pct(mv("trinity",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))` (Trinity), while MANE exact given
assembled falls from `r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[1])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[2])` and
`r sprintf("%.2f", full_mane[3])` (unfiltered) to `r sprintf("%.2f", mv("lraa",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`,
`r sprintf("%.2f", mv("stringtie",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))` and
`r sprintf("%.2f", mv("trinity",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`. Between 50 and 100 aa, MANE
exact given assembled changes by
`r paste(sprintf("%.3f", sapply(ASM, function(a) mv(a,100,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled") - mv(a,50,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))), collapse = ", ")`
and the no-overlap share by
`r paste(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sapply(ASM, function(a) mv(a,100,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac") - mv(a,50,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"))), collapse = ", ")`
points (LRAA, StringTie, Trinity).

`r evidence("E40")`

```{r chk_minaa, include = FALSE}
chk("L53 LRAA no-overlap at 150 aa (%)", 100 * mv("lraa",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"), 1.0)
chk("L53 StringTie no-overlap at 150 aa (%)", 100 * mv("stringtie",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"), 3.3)
chk("L53 Trinity no-overlap at 150 aa (%)", 100 * mv("trinity",150,"pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac"), 2.2)
chk("L54 LRAA MANE exact given assembled, unfiltered", full_mane[["lraa"]], 0.93, 2)
chk("L54 StringTie MANE exact given assembled, unfiltered", full_mane[["stringtie"]], 0.91, 2)
chk("L54 Trinity MANE exact given assembled, unfiltered", full_mane[["trinity"]], 0.89, 2)
chk("L54 LRAA MANE exact given assembled, >= 150 aa", mv("lraa",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"), 0.85, 2)
chk("L54 StringTie MANE exact given assembled, >= 150 aa", mv("stringtie",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"), 0.86, 2)
chk("L54 Trinity MANE exact given assembled, >= 150 aa", mv("trinity",150,"MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"), 0.83, 2)
```

## Homology evidence and evolutionary distance {#homology-evidence-and-evolutionary-distance}

Source: `data/gm12878/gm12878_homology_series_v7h.tsv` (E06 release rerun; run at a5b24c3, same code tree as the
pinned d3892b5, with the homology-assisted start refinement, release defaults; one fresh LongOrfs per assembly;
the ab initio row is byte-identical to the pinned-commit default run). Change = configuration minus ab initio.

```{r homology}
CLADES <- c("9606" = "human", "9443" = "primates", "40674" = "mammals", "7742" = "vertebrates",
            "33208" = "animals")
h <- function(a, cfg, col) hom[[col]][hom$assembly == a & hom$config == cfg]
hom_d <- hom %>% group_by(assembly) %>%
  mutate(d_mane_exact_pts = 100 * (MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled - MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled[config == "abinitio"]),
         d_mane_compat_pts = 100 * (MANE_sens_compatible - MANE_sens_compatible[config == "abinitio"]),
         d_distinct_cds = distinct_predicted_cds - distinct_predicted_cds[config == "abinitio"]) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(hom_d %>% select(assembly, config, distinct_predicted_cds, MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled,
                       d_mane_exact_pts, d_mane_compat_pts, d_distinct_cds), digits = 3)
dh <- function(a, cfg, col) hom_d[[col]][hom_d$assembly == a & hom_d$config == cfg]
```

- Swiss-Prot minus human, MANE exact given assembled: +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`
  (LRAA), +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))` (StringTie),
  +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))` (Trinity) points; MANE compatible
  +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`, +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`,
  +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","d_mane_compat_pts"))`.
- Minus all animals: +`r f1(dh("lraa","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`,
  +`r f1(dh("stringtie","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`, +`r f1(dh("trinity","blast_33208_nopfam","d_mane_exact_pts"))`.
- Pfam alone: `r pct(h("lraa","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`, `r pct(h("stringtie","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`,
  `r pct(h("trinity","pfam","MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled"))`; Swiss-Prot minus human:

## Homology to transposable elements retains short unannotated ORFs {#homology-to-transposable-elements}

Source: `data/gm12878/gm12878_homology_primate_retention_v7h.txt` (E06 release rerun;
`homology_series_retention.py`, Swiss-Prot minus human vs minus primates, BLAST only). Parsed below.

```{r retention}
prot_n <- function(line, prot) {
  m <- regmatches(line, regexec(sprintf("\\('%s', (\\d+)\\)", prot), line))[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 2) as.integer(m[2]) else 0L
}
parse_ret <- function(asm, txt = ret_txt) {
  i <- which(txt == paste("==", asm))
  blk <- txt[(i + 1):(i + 4)]
  n_only <- as.integer(sub("in A only: (\\d+) .*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  novel <- as.integer(sub(".*'novel': (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  short <- as.integer(sub(".*short\\(<100aa\\): (\\d+).*", "\\1", blk[1]))
  tibble(assembly = asm, only_minus_human = n_only, unannotated = novel, short_lt100 = short,
         best_hit_UTY_PANTR = prot_n(blk[3], "UTY_PANTR"), best_hit_LIN1_NYCCO = prot_n(blk[3], "LIN1_NYCCO"),
         best_hit_LORF2_MOUSE = prot_n(blk[3], "LORF2_MOUSE"))
}
ret <- bind_rows(parse_ret("trinity"), parse_ret("stringtie"), parse_ret("lraa"))
kable(ret, caption = "Release (a5b24c3)")
r <- function(a, col) ret[[col]][ret$assembly == a]
```

Trinity: `r num(r("trinity","only_minus_human"))` distinct CDSs with Swiss-Prot minus human but not
minus primates; `r num(r("trinity","unannotated"))` with no annotated CDS overlap;
`r pct(r("trinity","short_lt100") / r("trinity","only_minus_human"), 0)` encode fewer than 100 aa
(`r num(r("trinity","short_lt100"))`, counted over all `r num(r("trinity","only_minus_human"))`);
`r num(r("trinity","best_hit_UTY_PANTR"))` have chimpanzee UTY as best hit and
`r r("trinity","best_hit_LIN1_NYCCO")` a primate LINE-1 protein (LIN1_NYCCO). MANE exact (all MANE):
`r sprintf("%.4f", h("trinity","blast_9606_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact"))` (minus human) and
`r sprintf("%.4f", h("trinity","blast_9443_nopfam","MANE_sens_exact"))` (minus primates). StringTie:
`r num(r("stringtie","best_hit_UTY_PANTR"))` of `r num(r("stringtie","unannotated"))`.
These numbers also appear in the Fig. 7d annotation.

`r evidence("E06")`

Transposable-element screen (`pipeline/derive/08_te_screen_check_v7h.sh`, the recipe of PyTD
`docs/homology_te_screen.md`, d3892b5): ORFs predicted with Swiss-Prot minus human (BLAST only) but not
ab initio, flagged by best-hit name, by at least half of the CDS in RepeatMasker TEs, or either.

## Figure 7 {#figure-7}

Port of `figures/fig7_parameters/make_fig7.py`. All panels are from the pinned release code (E40):

- (a) the alpha x w grid on all three assemblies; the default cell is the release default.
- (b) lines are the post-hoc filter on the release predictions; markers are the q settings at the
  50-codon minimum: q 0.01, q 0.05 (default) and q 0.2 (drawn at 45, 50 and 55 aa so they do not overlap).
- (c, d) the homology series (E06).

```{r fig7_panels}
# (a) start refinement
pa_dat <- grid %>% filter(config != "norefine", weight %in% c(0, 17)) %>%
  mutate(w = ifelse(weight == 17, "w = 17/bit", "w = 0"), assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
pa_lab <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 17, alpha %in% c(0.2, 1.0)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("α = ", alpha))
pa_def <- pa_dat %>% filter(weight == 17, alpha == 0.4)
pa <- ggplot(pa_dat, aes(MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled, pred_complete_start_precision,
                         colour = assembly, group = interaction(assembly, w))) +
  geom_path(aes(linetype = w), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = w), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = pa_def, aes(group = NULL), shape = 21, size = 3, colour = "black", stroke = 0.35) +
  geom_text(data = pa_lab, aes(label = label, group = NULL, hjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 1.15, -0.1),
                               vjust = ifelse(alpha < 0.5, 0.5, 1.3)),
            size = 1.95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = "solid", "w = 0" = "22"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("w = 17/bit" = 16, "w = 0" = 21), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.83, 0.975)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.5, 0.9, 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "MANE exact given assembled", y = "exact-start share of\ncompatible complete calls",
       title = "Start refinement (α)", caption = "large circle: release default") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 5.5, hjust = 0)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.5), legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
        legend.key.width = unit(5, "mm"))

# (b) minimum length
QSET <- c(precise = "q 0.01", default = "q 0.05 (default)", sensitive = "q 0.2")
QSHAPE <- c("q 0.01" = 25, "q 0.05 (default)" = 23, "q 0.2" = 24)
pb_lines <- sweep_v7 %>% mutate(assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
# markers drawn at 45 / 50 / 55 aa so they do not overlap; all three runs use the 50-codon minimum
pb_pts <- q_tab %>% mutate(qs = factor(QSET[setting], levels = QSET),
                           min_aa = c(precise = 45, default = 50, sensitive = 55)[setting],
                           assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_b <- function(col_line, col_pt, ylab, title, legend = FALSE) {
  ggplot(pb_lines, aes(min_aa, .data[[col_line]], colour = assembly)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = pb_pts, aes(y = .data[[col_pt]], shape = qs), fill = "white", size = 1.6,
               stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = QSHAPE, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 100, 150, 200, 300)) +
    labs(x = "minimum protein length (aa)", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(legend.position = if (legend) "inside" else "none", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.98), legend.justification = c(1, 1))
}
pb1 <- panel_b("MANE_sens_exact_given_assembled", "MANE_exact_given_assembled",
               "MANE exact given\nassembled", "Minimum length: accuracy")
pb2 <- panel_b("pred_all_no_GENCODE_CDS_overlap_frac", "no_GENCODE_overlap",
               "no GENCODE CDS\noverlap (fraction)", "Minimum length: unannotated", legend = TRUE)

# (c, d) homology
XLEV <- c(paste0("−", CLADES), "Pfam\nonly")
PFAM_X <- 5.6
hom_pl <- hom_d %>% filter(config != "abinitio") %>%
  mutate(taxid = sub("blast_(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", config),
         db = case_when(config == "pfam" ~ "Pfam only",
                        grepl("_nopfam$", config) ~ "Swiss-Prot",
                        TRUE ~ "Swiss-Prot + Pfam"),
         x = ifelse(config == "pfam", "Pfam\nonly", paste0("−", CLADES[taxid])),
         xn = ifelse(config == "pfam", PFAM_X, match(x, XLEV)),
         assembly = factor(assembly, levels = ASM))
panel_cd <- function(col, scale, ylab, title) {
  d <- hom_pl %>% mutate(y = .data[[col]] * scale)
  ggplot(d %>% filter(db != "Pfam only"), aes(xn, y, colour = assembly,
                                               group = interaction(assembly, db))) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = db), linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = db), size = 1.1, fill = "white", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(db == "Pfam only"), aes(shape = db, linetype = db), size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, guide = "none") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = "solid", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = "22", "Pfam only" = "blank"),
                          breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Swiss-Prot" = 16, "Swiss-Prot + Pfam" = 21, "Pfam only" = 18),
                       breaks = c("Swiss-Prot", "Swiss-Prot + Pfam", "Pfam only"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1:5, PFAM_X), labels = XLEV, limits = c(0.6, 5.9)) +
    labs(x = "Swiss-Prot with clade removed", y = ylab, title = title) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
pc <- panel_cd("d_mane_exact_pts", 1, "Δ MANE exact given assembled\n(percentage points)",
               "Homology evidence: accuracy") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.02), legend.justification = c(0, 0), legend.key.width = unit(5, "mm"))
uty_y <- dh("trinity", "blast_9606_nopfam", "d_distinct_cds") / 1000
pd <- panel_cd("d_distinct_cds", 1e-3, "Δ distinct predicted CDSs\n(thousands)",
               "Homology evidence: predictions") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  annotate("segment", x = 1.08, xend = 1.9, y = uty_y, yend = uty_y * 0.98, linewidth = 0.25,
           colour = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.95, y = uty_y * 0.98, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.8, size = 1.95,
           label = paste0(num(r("trinity", "best_hit_UTY_PANTR")),
                          " short unannotated ORFs kept only\nby homology to the Alu-encoded\n",
                          "C-terminus of chimpanzee UTY"))

# shared assembly legend
leg <- ggplot(tibble(assembly = factor(ASM, levels = ASM), x = 1, y = 1), aes(x, y, fill = assembly)) +
  geom_tile(alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ASM_COLOR, labels = ASM_LABEL, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1), nrow = 1)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(2.5, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.key.spacing.x = unit(3, "mm"))
get_legend <- function(p) {
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  i <- which(grepl("guide-box", sapply(g$grobs, function(x) x$name)) &
             !sapply(g$grobs, inherits, "zeroGrob"))
  g$grobs[[i[1]]]
}
leg <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = get_legend(leg))

fig7 <- leg / ((pa | pb1 | pb2) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1))) / ((pc | pd)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.06, 1, 1.05)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("", "a", "b", "", "c", "d")))
png_f <- save_fig(fig7, "fig7_parameters", FULL_W, 5.0)
```
